headline: The funnel works end to end; the finish is what is left
note: An end-to-end test now walks home → inventory → configurator → checkout → confirmation and passes 17 of 17 checks: filters narrow the results, every option moves the price, an empty submit is refused with field-level messages, and a completed form places a real order. The remaining work is finish, not function.
constraint: tesla.com cannot be reached from this build sandbox: Tesla's edge (Akamai) blocks the datacenter IP for direct requests and for every public screenshot service tried, web.archive.org is blocked by this environment's egress policy, and Chromium here has no outbound HTTPS at all. Live side-by-side capture of the real funnel is therefore impossible from inside this session. Critics score against docs/reference-spec.md — the Tesla funnel written down as measurable properties — plus their own knowledge of that funnel, and every round must still name the single largest remaining gap.
